prompt: Tom's rubber food cloth keeps his kitchen floor the (clean) on the street.
explanation_ru: Односложное прилагательное clean образует превосходную степень с помощью суффикса -est: cleanest.

prompt: Are weekday rides on the little hill bus (quiet) than weekend trips?
explanation_ru: Двусложное прилагательное quiet обычно образует сравнительную степень с суффиксом -er (quieter; допустимо также more quiet).

prompt: Biscuit mix rolls (evenly) when you use a wide wooden pin.
explanation_ru: Наречия на -ly образуют сравнительную степень с помощью слова more: more evenly.

prompt: We didn't wear thin cotton gloves because sharp shells cut them the (fast).
explanation_ru: Короткое наречие fast без окончания -ly образует превосходную степень с суффиксом -est: (the) fastest.

prompt: A cheeky stage dog stole the bread and won the (loud) applause.
explanation_ru: Односложное прилагательное loud образует превосходную степень через -est (loudest), а не most loud.

prompt: My warm cream roll tasted (good) than the pricey cake at our hotel.
explanation_ru: У прилагательного good неправильная сравнительная степень better.

prompt: Fifteen neighbours jumped out with paper medals on the (happy) morning of my life.
explanation_ru: У прилагательного на согласную + -y буква y меняется на i перед -est: happy → happiest.

prompt: Aoife didn't stay nervous because the warm lights looked (soft) and the nurse spoke (cheerfully) than she expected.
explanation_ru: Односложное soft принимает -er (softer), а наречие на -ly образует сравнение с more (more cheerfully).

prompt: Sandro brushed the soil (carefully) than before and lifted the (tiny) clay toy horse he had ever seen.
explanation_ru: Наречие carefully требует more (more carefully), а в прилагательном tiny буква y меняется на i перед -est (tiniest).

prompt: Wasn't the cafe owner (friendly) and didn't he listen (closely) than the strict panels at Maribel's previous job?
explanation_ru: Прилагательное friendly на -y меняет y на i (friendlier; также возможно more friendly), а наречие closely требует more closely.

prompt: Turning the wooden grain wheel themselves kept my nephews (busy) and (excited) than looking at old gears behind ropes.
explanation_ru: В слове busy буква y переходит в i (busier), а причастие excited образует сравнительную степень через more.

prompt: Our visiting conductor wears bright yellow trainers, dances (wildly) than the students, and runs the (lively) rehearsals in town.
explanation_ru: Наречие wildly требует more (more wildly), а двусложное прилагательное lively на -y меняет y на i перед -est (liveliest).

prompt: Why does Mackenzie spend (much) free time in the library now that it has the (comfortable) green cushions in school?
explanation_ru: Сравнительная степень от much — неправильная форма more, а длинное прилагательное comfortable требует most.

prompt: Although Arturo expected a blurry dot, Jupiter's striped clouds shone (brightly) than in his books, making this the (clear) view of the planets he had ever seen.
explanation_ru: Наречие на -ly (brightly) образует сравнительную степень с more, а односложное прилагательное clear принимает -est (clearest).

prompt: Because cheering schoolchildren lined the final hill, Lunga felt (little) tired than on his training runs and crossed the line (soon) than he had hoped.
explanation_ru: Сравнительная степень от little — неправильная форма less, а короткое наречие soon принимает суффикс -er (sooner).

prompt: Nobody at Meredith's workshop expected two retired carpenters to code (neatly) than the college students and win the prize for the (useful) local website.
explanation_ru: Наречие neatly образует сравнение через more, а прилагательное с суффиксом -ful (useful) требует most.

prompt: When the coastal mist cleared before lunch, the sea became the (blue) we had seen all season, and we walked (far) along the sand than we had planned.
explanation_ru: К прилагательному на -e добавляется только -st (bluest), а far имеет неправильную форму further или farther.

prompt: Quentin wanted to hang new curtains in his flat. He thought the job would take twenty minutes. Instead, the wooden poles were (heavy) than he thought, and the hooks worked (badly) than old nails. He ended up eating toast on the floor.
explanation_ru: В слове heavy буква y меняется на i перед -er (heavier), а у наречия badly неправильная форма сравнения — worse.

prompt: Josip worried that his cheap room in Zadar would face a dark street. When he opened the wooden shutters, sweet flowers filled the air. The garden was (wide) than he imagined, and the mornings started the (peacefully) of his whole summer trip. He decided to stay two extra nights.
explanation_ru: К слову wide на -e добавляется только -r (wider), а наречие на -ly образует превосходную степень с most (most peacefully).

prompt: I ordered a big wool picnic blanket online for weekend park trips. A tiny parcel arrived in my front hall this morning. The blanket inside was (thin) than my kitchen towel and fit (well) in a doll's house than on grass. That is the (bad) online mistake I have ever made.
explanation_ru: В thin удваивается согласная n (thinner), а у well и bad неправильные степени сравнения — better и worst.

prompt: Do you ever dread confusing paper timetables in a new city? Shota felt lost when he walked into the central bus hub in Kanazawa. Luckily, the glowing screens looked (simple) than the old maps, and the drivers spoke (politely) than anyone he had met before. He caught the garden bus with time to spare.
explanation_ru: Двусложное simple на -le обычно принимает -r (simpler), а наречие politely требует конструкции с more.

prompt: Dear Dad, my statistics exam in St Andrews didn't go badly at all! The clear practice sheet helped me think (calmly) than in my mock test, and I finished (early) than half the hall. Afterwards, my friends and I drank the (good) pot of tea on the high street. I can finally relax tonight.
explanation_ru: Наречие calmly образует сравнение с more, в early буква y меняется на i (earlier), а у good превосходная степень — best.

prompt: Our office in Zurich installed an expensive smart heater before winter began. Somehow, the meeting room stayed (cold) than the hallway outside, while the tiny coat cupboard grew the (hot) space in the building. Staff now spend (little) time at their desks and fetch their coats (often) than ever before. Reto still laughs whenever the engineer visits.
explanation_ru: Односложное cold принимает -er, в hot удваивается t (hottest), у little неправильная форма less, а с наречием often используется more.

prompt: Kaito visited a small owl cafe in Niigata expecting lively birds hopping from branch to branch. Instead, four round snowy owls blinked slowly on warm wool cushions for the whole hour. They acted the (sleepy) of all the cafe animals he had photographed, and they had the (fluffy) feathers he had ever seen. If you want quiet company, you will not find a (gentle) spot in town.
explanation_ru: У sleepy и fluffy буква y меняется на i перед -est (sleepiest, fluffiest), а двусложное gentle на -le обычно принимает -r (gentler).

prompt: After trying five overnight coastal buses from Piura, I can easily pick a winner. Blue Line offers the (wide) seats and drives the (smoothly) along bumpy coastal roads. Because its drivers take (few) risks at night, passengers sleep (well) than on the cheaper express coaches. I always book it weeks ahead now.
explanation_ru: К wide добавляется -st (widest), наречие smoothly требует most, с исчисляемым risks нужно fewer, а у well форма сравнения — better.

prompt: I expected my first Monday at the shipping office in Riga to feel lonely. Within an hour, three colleagues shared fresh rye bread and told jokes around my desk. They welcomed me the (warmly) of any team I have joined, and the afternoon flew by the (quickly) of my whole working week. Even my (old) brother admitted he was jealous of my new workplace.
explanation_ru: Наречия на -ly (warmly, quickly) образуют превосходную степень с most, а для старшего брата перед существительным используется elder (или older).

prompt: Aisling's first rice cakes looked ___ than the messy ones in her book.
explanation_ru: Односложное neat имеет долгий гласный звук, поэтому t не удваивается: neater (не neatter и не more neat).

prompt: Real space gloves are much ___ than ordinary winter gloves!
explanation_ru: Односложное thick образует сравнительную степень с -er (thicker). Формы more thick и thickker ошибочны.

prompt: Why is the paid fast-track lane moving ___ than the free queue?
explanation_ru: После глагола moving нужно наречие slowly в сравнительной степени more slowly; формы slowlier не существует.

prompt: Lovisa bought slim under-bed linen drawers because they hide bulky winter jumpers ___ than open shelves.
explanation_ru: Глагол hide требует наречия tidily, которое образует сравнительную степень через more tidily (не прилагательное tidier).

prompt: Don't order the pricey grill plate when the warm aubergine rolls are the ___ dish on the menu.
explanation_ru: У прилагательного tasty буква y меняется на i перед -est (tastiest). Двойная степень most tastiest и написание tastyest неверны.

prompt: Even if the stone pier near Chania tower is ___ from the bus station than the main beach, Yannis still recommends walking there at dawn.
explanation_ru: Сравнительная степень от far для расстояния — farther (или further). Варианты farer и more far ошибочны.

prompt: Bring a thick scarf because thiner ones let the sea wind through.
answer: Bring a thick scarf because thinner ones let the sea wind through.
accepted_answers: Bring a thick scarf because thinner ones let the sea wind through.
explanation_ru: В односложном thin перед суффиксом -er согласная n удваивается: thinner, а не thiner.

prompt: Serena told us that the baker's warm lemon pastries tasted more good than any dessert in Amalfi.
answer: Serena told us that the baker's warm lemon pastries tasted better than any dessert in Amalfi.
accepted_answers: Serena told us that the baker's warm lemon pastries tasted better than any dessert in Amalfi.
explanation_ru: Прилагательное good имеет неправильную сравнительную степень better; конструкция more good — типичная ошибка.

prompt: Stoyan wrote that the seaside hostel had cleaner staff rooms and fairer managers than his previous summer job.
answer: Stoyan wrote that the seaside hostel had cleaner staff rooms and fairer managers than his previous summer job.
accepted_answers: Stoyan wrote that the seaside hostel had cleaner staff rooms and fairer managers than his previous summer job.
explanation_ru: Предложение написано без ошибок: односложные прилагательные clean и fair правильно принимают суффикс -er (cleaner, fairer).

prompt: When icy sea fog rolls across the boat, Hakon insists that a simple brass compass is the most easy tool to read without cold fingers slipping.
answer: When icy sea fog rolls across the boat, Hakon insists that a simple brass compass is the easiest tool to read without cold fingers slipping.
accepted_answers: When icy sea fog rolls across the boat, Hakon insists that a simple brass compass is the easiest tool to read without cold fingers slipping.
explanation_ru: Двусложное easy на -y образует превосходную степень с заменой y на i и суффиксом -est (the easiest), а не the most easy.

prompt: Maciej joked that walking over the temporary footbridge gets office workers across the river more fast than waiting for the slow replacement shuttle.
answer: Maciej joked that walking over the temporary footbridge gets office workers across the river faster than waiting for the slow replacement shuttle.
accepted_answers: Maciej joked that walking over the temporary footbridge gets office workers across the river faster than waiting for the slow replacement shuttle.
explanation_ru: Короткое наречие fast образует сравнительную степень с помощью -er (faster), а не со словом more.

prompt: Bronagh wants parents to know the police scooter-marking event helps children keep their scooters safe. Which sentence is right?
options: Marked scooters are more safe than unmarked ones.
Marked scooters are safeer than unmarked ones.
Marked scooters are safer than unmarked ones.
Marked scooters are the safest than unmarked ones.
explanation_ru: Односложное safe оканчивается на -e, поэтому к нему добавляется только -r (safer). Варианты more safe, safeer и the safest than ошибочны.

prompt: Zara likes the basement music club because soft curtains stop loud echoes during live songs. Which review fits best?
options: Live songs sound much clearer here than in big noisy halls.
Live songs sound much more clearlier here than in big noisy halls.
Live songs sound much clearrer here than in big noisy halls.
Live songs sound much the clearest here than in big noisy halls.
explanation_ru: После глагола-связки sound нужно прилагательное clearer (без удвоения r и без смешения со словом more или превосходной степенью).

prompt: Vreni reminds club members that using two-step text codes protects their accounts better than reusing a short pet name. Which notice is grammatically correct?
options: A short pet name is the most bad password you can choose for your online accounts.
Two-step text codes guard your accounts far more safely than a short repeated pet name.
Two-step text codes guard your accounts far saferly than a short repeated pet name.
Reusing one pet name on every account is more worse than writing a note at home.
explanation_ru: Наречие safely образует сравнительную степень через more safely. Формы most bad, saferly и more worse содержат типичные ошибки.

prompt: No other study booths in the building are quieter before exams than the upstairs ones. → The upstairs study booths are the …
answer: The upstairs study booths are the quietest in the building before exams.
accepted_answers: The upstairs study booths are the quietest in the building before exams.
The upstairs study booths are the quietest ones in the building before exams.
The upstairs study booths are the quietest study booths in the building before exams.
The upstairs study booths are the most quiet in the building before exams.
The upstairs study booths are the most quiet ones in the building before exams.
explanation_ru: Конструкция «ни одни другие не тише» перестраивается в превосходную степень от quiet: the quietest (допустимо также the most quiet).

prompt: Hayley is a more careful walker on wet timber paths than the rest of our group. → Hayley walks on wet timber paths …
answer: Hayley walks on wet timber paths more carefully than the rest of our group.
accepted_answers: Hayley walks on wet timber paths more carefully than the rest of our group.
explanation_ru: При замене существительного walker глаголом walks сравнительная степень прилагательного more careful переходит в наречие more carefully.
